newsitem.title: USA: Allen Group, NextWave in vendor deal.
newsitem.headline: Allen Group, NextWave in vendor deal.

text.p: Allen Group Inc and NextWave Telecommunications Inc said Wednesday they entered into a five-year vendor agreement which allows NextWave to purchase $50 million in wireless Personal Communications Systems, or PCS, products and services from Allen and its subsidiaries.
Allen Group said in a release Wednesday that it agreed to make an equity investment of $5 million in NextWave and will extend up to $50 million in financing for products purchased from Allen.
The products and services will be used by NextWave in the build-out and implementation of its national PCS network, Allen Group said.
The company added that the range of possible products and services include software and engineering services to be used in designing the radio frequency network and its microwave elements.
